notes.title: Big-O Complexity Cheat Notes (IF202)
notes.content: Always analyze worst-case vs amortized time complexity. Hash tables give O(1) average lookup, while balanced BSTs (AVL / Red-Black) guarantee O(log n) even under adversarial keys.

notes.title: PostgreSQL Indexing Rules of Thumb
notes.content: Use B-Tree indexes for equality and range queries. For composite indexes (a, b), column order matters—place the highest-selectivity or equality column first.
notes.codeBlock:
CREATE INDEX idx_tasks_status_deadline
ON tasks (status, deadline ASC);
